book.name: MATAIYO
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Mataiyo wana Leleli

content: Tosiba Hi Nem Yeisu elana
Yeisu hi ab Bedeliyema, Yudiya ana labi elana, sauga toto Helodi iya wali kin. Inoke tosiba enuna hi loem nati hi nem Yelusalema,
yaka hi nel hi ba, “Wawaya toto hi ab tage Yudiya wali kin iya ga? Ana etotohi putum ha kitek nati, inoke ha nem ge naha kululu elana.”
Sauga Kin Helodi wasa ya i hago i nuwanuwatu nabi, i ola al Yelusalema ana tomina hi gewigewi.
Topowon bwabwatal ge Logugui ana topankite i yoga gogonil ge i nelil i ba, “Mesaiya ga nihi aba?”
Hi ba, “Bedeliyema, Yudiya ana labi elana, kaiwena palopita i leli i ola hiwe:

content.text: Komiu Bedeliyema, Yudiya ana labi elana,
nige bosowaina ta ba alamiu nige i bwabwata Yudiya ana tohouwa gamwaliyaa,
kaiwena tohouwa etega ni masal gamwamiwa
inoke no gamagalau Isileli ni nulil.”

content: Yaka Helodi i ba tosiba hi nem alonau hi liwan sumi, inoke i nelil hauna sauga hot putum ya i masal.
Yaka abwe i patunal hi na Bedeliyema i ba, “Ku na ga wawaya nuku loyaan bubun. Sauga ebo nuku pwawa inoke no wasa nuku pem, yaka nau al ge na na na kululu elana.”

Tosiba kin anana hi hago inoke hi nawanawa al, yaka putum toto hi kitek nati hi kite al. He sauga hi kite, hi yaliyaya bubun hot. Inoke putum i houwaagil ana siga i veyahowa awan toto wawaya i miminaa pwatanaa.
Yaka hi na hi ulutuk limiya ge wawaya hi kite alona hinana Meli, inoke hi loepwakoku ge hi kululu elana. Wali gogomwau ana nabwa hi pwela inoke wali mulolu hi pek, gold, plenkinsens
ge enonu toto alana meya.
Kenonou elana Yehoba i baek elal bahi nihi sisikal Helodi elana, inoke hi noek kamwasa getoga elana hi na wali panuwaa.
Yosepa ge Meli Wawaya Hi Palou Hi Na Itipita

Sauga tosiba hi egon, yaka Yosepa ana kenonou elana Yehoba wana anelose i masal elana ge i ba, “Helodi nasi wawaya ni loyaan nuwana ni tagapaaliga. U lut, wawaya alona ge hinana u ahel ge ku lou ku na Itipita. Inoke nuku miminaa ga o ana siga na ba, yaka abwe nuku sikal.”
Yaka Yosepa i lut, wawaya alona ge hinana i ahel inoke bulina hi egon hi na Itipita,
ge hi miminaa ga o ana siga Helodi i aliga. He i masal i ola to, inoke Yehoba wana baaba toto palopita etega i pamasal i tabwa tunahot, i ba, “Natu ya yogaan i tagila Itipita.”
Helodi Wawayau I Tagapaaligal

Sauga Helodi i atena age tosiba hi kakawe, inoke i huga nabi. Yaka wana tolohaveyan i patunal ge wawayau melutauil Bedeliyema ge ana labi gegewena, bolo wali baliman eluwa ge gabulanaa, hi tagapaaligal. I golugoluwa sauga toto tosiba hi pamasal ge putum i masal.
He i masal i ola to, inoke Yelemaiya wana baaba i tabwa tunahot, i ba:

content.text: Anan etega hi hago Lama elana,

content: Hi Na Nasaleta
Wali minamina ana siga Helodi i aliga, inoke Itipita elana Yehoba wana anelose i masal Yosepa ana kenonou elana
ge i ba, “U lut, wawaya alona ge hinana u ahel ge ku sikal labi Isileli, kaiwena toto nuwana wawaya ni lol iyaka i aliga.”
Inoke Yosepa i lut, wawaya alona ge hinana i ahel ge hi sikal labi Isileli.

Yaa sauga i hago Akeleyas i tabwa kin labi Yudiya elana, tamana Helodi abana i milahe, inoke Yosepa i lovakun nok to labi o elana. Ana kenonou elana Yehoba i baek elana inoke i nok i na Galili ana labi elana,
ge i na i miminaa panuwa Nasaleta. He i masal i ola to, inoke palopitau wali baaba i tabwa tunahot, hi ba, “Gamagalau nihi ba iya gagama Nasaleta.”

footnotes.text: Plenkinsens ebwakil etega suina hi ton bwalena i waisi.
